# 墨池 Inkpond

> Inkpond is an ink-wash background library for web developers: animated Chinese glyphs behind your page that answer the pointer, give an empty landing, sign-in or AI chat screen some atmosphere, and stay out of the content's way. Canvas 2D, zero runtime dependencies, MIT licensed, with an optional React component.

墨池（Inkpond）是给网页开发者用的背景库：在页面背后铺一层会回应鼠标的水墨汉字动画，让空白的首页、登录页或 AI 对话页有东方意境，又不遮挡内容、不拖慢页面。

Key facts:

- Three scenes: `shanshui` (hills in mist, default), `lotus` (lotus pond whose koi avoid the pointer and swim to dropped ink), `qingming` (a handscroll of Along the River During the Qingming Festival that keeps unrolling).
- Interaction: the pointer stirs ripples, a click or tap drops ink; elements marked `data-inkpond-avoid` keep a clear zone that koi, boats and walkers steer around.
- Install (not on npm yet): `npm i github:shin4/inkpond`. Then `import "inkpond/inkpond.css"` and either `<InkPond scene="lotus" />` from `inkpond/react` (React 18+) or `createInkPond(canvas, { scene })` from `inkpond` in any framework.
- Programmatic input: `pond.ripple(clientX, clientY, strength)` and `pond.drop(clientX, clientY)`.
- Performance: glyphs are rasterised once into an atlas; 0.2–0.7 ms of script per calm frame, p95 under 1.9 ms when fully stirred (1920×1080, DPR 1.5). Frame rate drops when calm, stops after 30 s idle, pauses in hidden tabs, and steps down on weak devices or software rendering.
- Accessibility: the canvas is `aria-hidden`; reduced motion draws a still picture; forced-colours mode hides it.
- Colours: ink and four pale pigments (vermilion, rouge, ochre, indigo) are CSS variables with dark-mode values; `tint: false` for ink only.
- Licence: code MIT; the bundled glyph subsets of Source Han Serif SC are SIL OFL 1.1, renamed Inkpond Glyphs.
- Inspired by stackedlol/ascii-sharks; written from scratch.
